'''Laz''' was one of four continents on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lazerian IV]].

==Description==
It was located mostly on the planet's western hemisphere and contained the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Lazeria City]] as well as [[Devit (city)|Devit]] and [[Dorynn]] and a [[ruined outpost]].<ref name="LIV" /> The terrain was mostly made up of plains, with a large mountain range along the western coast.<ref name="PLTK" /> Together with [[Elgar]] and [[Torm]], it made up the [[Kingdom of Devit]].<ref name="LIV" />
